lines: Observatory: Sierra Remote Observatory, Auberry, California, USA; MPC U69
Min target elevation: Approx. 25 degrees (portal says 20°: CONFLICT)
Coordinates 37.07 N, 119.4 W; elevation 1405 m / 4610 ft

Ops notes: deep field, hybrid missions, photometry and imaging, FITS and TIF; darks 900 s Bin2; recommended max exposure 600 s (portal max 900 s); all sessions forced to Bin2 due to processing pipeline limitations; largest in network; Planewave Ascension 200HR, active guidance disabled for exposures under 300 s, recommend 300 s or less

Camera: Player One Zeus 455M Pro (CMOS, IMX455), QE 90% peak, gain 0.25 e-/ADU, full well ~17,000 e-, dark 0.00154 e/s/pix at 0 C, 3.76 µm pixels, 0.395 arcsec/pixel (Bin2), cooling -10 C default, 4788x3194 (15 MP, Bin2), FOV 31.6 x 21.1 arcmin, position angle 90.7°
Filters: Astrodon LRGB2-E50S; HA3_50S, OIII3_50S, SII3_50S; V, I (V*-50S, Ic*-50S)
Optics: Planewave 24" (0.61 m) CDK, aperture 610 mm, focal length 3962 mm, f/6.5; guiding none; mount Planewave Ascension 200HR

run_saved_plan: repeats 900 s / 20° / 45°, Bias2 and Darks 900 s Bin2, outputs. Controls: folder dropdown "[select subfolder]"; plan dropdown (empty); checkboxes "Send my Images to the VPhot Server (requires AAVSO membership).", "Auto Logoff."; Acquire Images button (not clicked).

workflow: Planning Tool or Telescopius for coordinates/visibility
check framing in Telescopius with correct telescope
fill Deep Sky Objects form, suggested H:M:S / D:M:S (RA 05:23:25 DEC -10:12:56)
master calibration Bias2 and Darks 900 s Bin2 (dark scaled with bias)
Acquire images now or Create plan for later (Reservation)
watch via System Status or View Desktop
tips: stack many shorter subs (120 s x 10 = 1200 s master)
sky noise just exceeding dark current is ideal
brighter object shorter sub, darker filter longer
prefer #REPEAT over Qty (4x LRGB 1200 s cut at 3/4 gives L,R,G no B
notes: adaptive focus periodically and on temperature change, disabled by #FORCESTARTUP + #NOADAPTIVE.
Outputs: raw 16-bit FITS, calibrated 16-bit FITS, JPEG preview, optional 16-bit TIFF, optional calibrated FITS to VPhot..
